Having the exact same issue as you and I might have found what's causing it, at least on my laptop.

In my case, I have an NTFS drive that I can only use on a VPN or local network (by design). Right clicking on it when disconnected from the VPN would crash file explorer, so the real source of the bug could be with Windows. Removing the drive or connecting to the VPN means Godot starts up as normal.

I also have a webDAV mounted, but this isn't causing any problems even when I switch it off on the server's end.
it looks like it goes through this function twice when being launched for some reason, and disconnected network drives take about 8 seconds each before GetVolumeInformationW returns in error
in case anyone else wants to be running 4.7, trusts me, is running into the issue, and doesn't want to build, there is a build under releases with just the above change on my fork
